newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper settles firmer after LME stock drop.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper settles firmer after LME stock drop.

text.p: COMEX copper settled firmer in steady, post Presidents' Day holiday trading, gleaning some support from a 1,100 tonne drop in LME stocks Tuesday.
COMEX was closed on Monday. LME stocks now total 220,625 tonnes.
No other fresh fundamental factors were seen behind Tuesday's gains, traders said.
March COMEX copper settled at 109.60 cents per pound, up 1.90 cents from Friday's close, traded 109.70 to 108.40 cents. Volume was estimated at 9,500 lots.
After weakening slightly earlier on Tuesday, the LME backwardation firmed again to $72/$76.

Although the backwardation is well below its recent peak of more than $300, traders said they expected the tightness to rear its head again soon because part of it was rolled forward into early April.
After the close on Tuesday COMEX stocks rose 2,225 short tons to 20,640 short tons.
